# Bundled components

JavaFX Companion 0.3 bundles OpenJFX SDK 26 (Windows x64) and the Scene Builder 26.0.0 application/Kit JAR from the user's Gluon installation.

- OpenJFX: https://openjfx.io/ — GPL v2 with Classpath Exception; component notices are included under javafx/.
- Scene Builder: https://github.com/gluonhq/scenebuilder — BSD 3-Clause. The application JAR also contains third-party dependencies and their META-INF notices.

The installed Scene Builder executable is not launched or modified by this editor.
